metadata.description: Three Claude Code plugins: p4-phi, which keeps what linked sessions hand each other and retrieval from the project's own history; p4-temportal, which keeps what stands in for a default of Anthropic's own system: the auto memory directory, the session scratchpad directory, temp files and their lifetimes; and p4-skillex, which holds what a project would otherwise install a third-party plugin or MCP server for, as skills it writes in the project's store from what the project's sessions keep writing.

plugins.name: p4-temportal
plugins.description: Stands in for three of Claude Code's own places inside the project: the auto memory directory, the session scratchpad directory and temporary files, with lifetimes that clear what is no longer relevant.

plugins.name: p4-phi
plugins.description: What linked Claude Code sessions hand each other, and retrieval from the project's own history: rule and fact lines beside a message or a subagent's task when the ranker is confident, an earlier answer in place of a repeated web lookup, and what worked after a failure an earlier session met.

plugins.name: p4-skillex
plugins.description: Watches what a project's sessions write inside <project>/.claude/p4/temportal/ and turns the scripts they keep writing again into skills, each at <project>/.claude/p4/skillex/<skill_name>/SKILL.md. Only after a skill is written does it search for a similar skill that already exists, and it links the new skill to it. Every store skill is copied into the project's .claude/skills/ so each session of the project is offered it. It holds what a project would otherwise install a third-party plugin or MCP server for, shaped to that project's work.
